evals.name: calibrate_mmm_with_geo_lift_test
evals.prompt: We ran a Geo-lift experiment on Meta ads for base model 'mmm_base_2025'. In the test markets, baseline spend was $40k, spend increment was $20k, and incremental revenue measured was $50k with a 95% confidence interval of [$30.4k, $69.6k]. Calibrate the model.
evals.expected_output: The agent derives standard error sigma = (69600 - 30400) / (2 * 1.96) = 10000. It constructs a CalibrateMMMInput payload with channel='meta_spend', x=40000, delta_x=20000, delta_y=50000, sigma=10000, calls calibrate_mmm, notes the new calibrated model ID and parent lineage, and advises running diagnose_mmm on the new artifact.

assertions.text: agent computes standard error sigma = 10000 from the 95% confidence interval
agent calls calibrate_mmm with model_id and lift_tests list
agent highlights model lineage parent linkage and recommends diagnostic gating
assertions.evidence: Explains parent_model_id and diagnose_mmm next step

evals.name: recommend_next_measurement_experiment
evals.prompt: Our MMM shows wide credible intervals for Connected TV and TikTok ads. Which channels should we test first and what experiment should we design?
evals.expected_output: The agent recommends calling recommend_next_measurement(model_id) to evaluate parameter uncertainty. It explains how to set up a matched market test or geo-lift holdout to collect empirical delta_y and sigma for future calibration.

assertions.text: agent suggests using recommend_next_measurement to identify highest information gain
assertions.evidence: Tool recommend_next_measurement proposed for prioritizing test

assertions.text: agent details experimental design options (geo-lift or holdout)
